test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

C _ R C _ R _ A R _ A _ C A _

options.text: R A C A C A
R A C A A C
A C R A C R
A A C C R R

solution:
Given : C _ R C _ R _ A R _ A _ C A _ 

By checking options :

 
• R A C A C A → C **__R__** R C __A__ R __C__ A R **__A__** A **__C__** C A **__A__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• R A C A A C → C **__R__** R C __A__ R __C__ A R **__A__** A __R__ C A **__C__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• A C R A C R → C __A__ R C **__C__** R **__R__** A R **__A__** A **__C__** C A __R__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• A A C C R R → C __**A**__ R C __**A**__ R __**C**__ A R __**C**__ A __**R**__ C A __**R**__ → (It follows the pattern of : CAR - CAR - CAR - CAR - CAR)

⇒Option - (4) gives the pattern of "C __A__ R C __A__ R __C__ A R __C__ A __R__ C A __R__"

Hence, "**A A C C R R**" is the correct answer.
